description: This file defines configuration utilities for setting up an AVCaptureSession, including adding inputs and outputs for camera, microphone, photo, and movie recording, along with error handling.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfigurationError
classes.description: An enumeration of possible errors encountered during camera session configuration, conforming to LocalizedError to provide error descriptions.

classes.name: CameraSessionConfiguration
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to add camera input, photo output, and movie output to an AVCaptureSession with proper error handling.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the specified AVCaptureSession, throws if it fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Creates and adds a photo output to the session, configured for maximum quality, throws if it fails.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Creates and adds a movie output to the session, optionally adds microphone input if requested, and sets maximum recording duration, throws if it fails.
